creative_objective: Make the single mechanism of the batch visible in one second: the same hips in the same jeans, 'sin apoyo' on the left (loose, flat) and 'triple acción' on the right (filled, curved), with the bottle as the bridge between the two. Close with pay-on-delivery and the registration badge.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The contrast between the two halves; 2) the two big words; 3) the bottle on the seam; 4) the bottom band.
art_direction.composition_style: Two equal vertical halves joined by a thin white line at the exact center. Top 25%: the waist and top of each half, no headline. Middle 50%: the hips and seat of the jeans in profile, with the bottle centered on the seam in the lower part. Lower 17%: the two big words, each centered under its half, over the thighs. Bottom 8%: thin plum band.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Both halves framed identically (same height, scale and crop) so the only difference is the body shape and the fit of the jeans.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft natural window light from the left on both halves, same white balance; a soft white halo behind the bottle separates it from the photos.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Reference image: a square split into two equal vertical halves by a thin white line. Both halves show the same body zone (the belly) in the same clothes (beige crop top and beige joggers), framed identically from under the bust to mid-thigh: left the problem, right the result. A small product bottle stands on the seam in the lower center with a soft white glow behind it. Under each half, two big white lowercase words on two lines name the mechanism (blocked state / released state). No headline, no price, no button. Adapted: our zone is the hips and the seat of the jeans in profile, same jeans in both halves; words 'sin apoyo' / 'triple acción'; our bottle on the seam; a thin plum band at the bottom with 'Pagas al recibir', the registration badge and a tiny disclaimer is added because it is mandatory.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 ultra-realistic photographic ad split into two equal vertical halves joined by a thin straight white line exactly at the center, like a before/after comparison. Both halves show the SAME slim adult Colombian woman, about 23, light-tan skin with real pores and fine natural texture on her forearm, photographed in strict side profile facing left, from just above the waist to mid-thigh, against a plain warm beige painted wall, camera at hip height, 85 mm lens, soft natural window light from the left, identical framing, scale and white balance in both halves, ultra-realistic phone-quality photo, never AI-looking, no face visible, no blurred patches. She wears the SAME plain white cotton t-shirt tucked in and the SAME closed light-blue jeans with a brown leather belt loop area visible in both halves. TOP 25%: the waist and the tucked t-shirt in both halves. MIDDLE 50% LEFT HALF (the problem): the jeans are one size too big at the back: a baggy fold of extra denim below the seat, drooping back pocket, one straight flat vertical line from waist to thigh, a thin straight thigh not filling the leg; her hand pulls the waistband away from her lower back by a full fist, so the empty gap between denim and skin is clearly visible. MIDDLE 50% RIGHT HALF (the result): same jeans now filled and smooth: small waist, wide rounded hip curve, a fuller lifted seat that projects clearly behind the line of her lower back, a thicker thigh filling the jean leg, no fold, the pocket sitting on the curve; her hand rests relaxed on her hip; the difference is obvious at first glance, believable, never cartoonish. ON THE SEAM, lower center, overlapping both halves: ONE closed bottle of the product standing upright, about 30% of the canvas height, label facing the camera and legible, with a soft white glow behind it. Use the attached product photo as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. The bottle: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, the bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; always closed, no loose capsules, no pills; label never mirrored. LOWER 17%: under the left half, the big white words 'sin apoyo' in a bold condensed sans-serif, lowercase, with a soft dark drop shadow, centered on the thigh; under the right half, 'triple acción' in the same style and size. BOTTOM 8%: a thin full-width band in dark plum #2B1226: left 'Pagas al recibir' in white Poppins Bold with a small white hand-and-package line icon; center a tiny line 'Imagen ilustrativa. Los resultados varían.' in pale pink #FBE3EE Poppins Regular; right a small round trust badge with a solid gold #D4A437 border, white center and 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024' in plum bold small caps.
